nodes.name: Normalize Intake For Role Task Queue

parameters.query: WITH input_json AS ( SELECT $1::jsonb AS p ), input_data AS ( SELECT p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id, p->>'phase_run_id' AS phase_run_id, p->>'role_task_id' AS role_task_id, p->>'idempotency_key' AS idempotency_key, p->>'status' AS status, p->>'current_state' AS current_state, p->>'repository_full_name' AS repository_full_name, p->>'current_phase' AS current_phase, p->>'target_branch_name' AS target_branch_name, (p->>'max_retries')::integer AS max_retries, p->>'event_type' AS event_type, COALESCE(p->'event_payload_json', '{}'::jsonb) AS event_payload_json, COALESCE(p->'root_task_json', '{}'::jsonb) AS root_task_json, COALESCE(p->'task_payload_json', '{}'::jsonb) AS task_payload_json, COALESCE(p->'context_refs_json', '{}'::jsonb) AS context_refs_json, p->>'expected_output_schema_ref' AS expected_output_schema_ref FROM input_json ), upserted_run AS ( INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_runs ( workflow_run_id, idempotency_key, status, current_state, repository_full_name, current_phase, target_branch_name, max_retries, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT workflow_run_id, idempotency_key, status, current_state, repository_full_name, current_phase, target_branch_name, max_retries, now(), now() FROM input_data ON CONFLICT (workflow_run_id) DO UPDATE SET idempotency_key = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.idempotency_key, status = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.status, current_state = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.current_state, repository_full_name = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.repository_full_name, current_phase = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.current_phase, target_branch_name = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.target_branch_name, max_retries = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.max_retries, updated_at = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.updated_at RETURNING workflow_run_id, status, current_state, repository_full_name, current_phase, target_branch_name, retry_count, max_retries, created_at, updated_at, (xmax = 0) AS inserted ), inserted_event AS ( INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_run_events ( workflow_run_id, previous_state, new_state, event_type, event_payload_json, created_at ) SELECT u.workflow_run_id, NULL, u.current_state, d.event_type, d.event_payload_json, now() FROM upserted_run u CROSS JOIN input_data d WHERE u.inserted = true RETURNING event_id ), phase_run AS ( INSERT INTO public.route_b_phase_runs ( phase_run_id, workflow_run_id, repository_full_name, root_task_json, status, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT phase_run_id, workflow_run_id, repository_full_name, root_task_json, 'phase_run_created', now(), now() FROM input_data ON CONFLICT (phase_run_id) DO UPDATE SET workflow_run_id = public.route_b_phase_runs.workflow_run_id, repository_full_name = public.route_b_phase_runs.repository_full_name, root_task_json = public.route_b_phase_runs.root_task_json, status = public.route_b_phase_runs.status, updated_at = public.route_b_phase_runs.updated_at RETURNING phase_run_id, status AS phase_run_status ), initial_pm_l3_role_task AS ( INSERT INTO public.route_b_role_task_queue ( phase_run_id, workflow_run_id, role_task_id, parent_role_task_id, sequence_no, role_id, task_type, task_payload_json, context_refs_json, expected_output_schema_ref, status, attempt, max_retries, blocker_code, created_at, claimed_at, completed_at ) SELECT phase_run_id, workflow_run_id, role_task_id, NULL, 1, 'PM_L3_DELIVERY_VALIDATION_OWNER', 'pm_l3_planning', task_payload_json, context_refs_json, expected_output_schema_ref, 'role_task_ready', 0, 3, NULL, now(), NULL, NULL FROM input_data ON CONFLICT (role_task_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING role_task_id ), existing_pm_l3_role_task AS ( SELECT q.role_task_id FROM public.route_b_role_task_queue q JOIN input_data d ON q.role_task_id = d.role_task_id LIMIT 1 ) SELECT u.workflow_run_id, u.status, u.current_state, u.repository_full_name, u.current_phase, u.target_branch_name, u.retry_count, u.max_retries, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.inserted, e.event_id, p.phase_run_id, p.phase_run_status, COALESCE(i.role_task_id, x.role_task_id) AS initial_role_task_id, (i.role_task_id IS NOT NULL) AS initial_role_task_inserted FROM upserted_run u CROSS JOIN phase_run p LEFT JOIN inserted_event e ON true LEFT JOIN initial_pm_l3_role_task i ON true LEFT JOIN existing_pm_l3_role_task x ON true;
